# Final check: confirm the correct conversion rate calculation

# Compute conversion rate per segment using all rows

calc_conversion_rates = (
    df_all
    .groupby('customer_segment', as_index=False)
    .agg(
        total_orders=('order_id', 'count'),
        converted_orders=('converted', 'sum')
    )
    .assign(
        conversion_rate=lambda x: x['converted_orders'] / x['total_orders']
    )
)

# Sort by conversion rate descending
top_segment = calc_conversion_rates.sort_values('conversion_rate', ascending=False).iloc[0]

# Print results
print(calc_conversion_rates)
# Also print the top segment
print(f"Top segment: {top_segment['customer_segment']} with rate {top_segment['conversion_rate']:.4f}")

print("\n--- FULL RESULTS ---")
